gen-gf-autour-one-gf-victor-mono: Bold, expressive curves up top, with a monospace tucked underneath. Autour One earns its keep when the words are few and big, while Victor Mono spaces its glyphs loosely.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-voces: Voces stands tall in the lowercase, with stems and hairlines close in thickness, beneath Autour One. Voces makes pages of text feel steady and unfussy next to a heading whose line never swells.
gen-gf-autour-one-plus-jakarta-sans: A clear channel leads into every round letter of Autour One. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline strokes and moderate lowercase height out of the way, letting the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-autour-one-space-grotesk: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws round letters with a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, over Space Grotesk. Its best trick: loud display letters over body strokes of constant width.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tightly, with big counters in a tall lowercase and curves that stay open, below Balsamiq Sans. Pages of it read warm and friendly, never fussing for attention.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-quicksand: Bold, stencil-cut lines meet tall, bulb-round bowls as Balsamiq Sans leads and Quicksand carries the text below. Give the heading generous size so its constant weight has room to show.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-akatab: Balsamiq Sans bends its bold strokes like a paperclip, while Akatab shapes round letters that look cupped, not clenched. Let the heading go big and the sans text stay modest.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Balsamiq Sans holds a bold, pen-like line of constant weight, above Alegreya Sans SC and its welcoming gap in the c. Their best quality is a modern text face under a loud heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-anta: Anta reads like a bent-wire sign, approachable and businesslike, with gaping mouths on the e, under Balsamiq Sans. This sans-serif body keeps whole pages of text steady and friendly.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-antic: Bold stencil cuts above a one-nib sans-serif with open mouths. Shrink Balsamiq Sans and its constant-weight channel loses its punch, and a large Antic would crowd the heading out entirely.
